heroIntro: Get your boots on the ground with council member {councilName} and popular influencer {influencerName} on a three stop tour to experience the nightlife and support local businesses while building a relationship with your council member.
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

stops.title: {influencerName}'s Downtown Opener
stops.body: {influencerName} starts us on the {location} side of the river with a stop that blends music, mood, and a crowd that knows how to show up for local business.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Cross-River Choice
stops.body: Councilmember {councilName} picks a second stop that bridges Downtown and Algiers�somewhere with history, hospitality, and room for real neighborhood conversation.

stops.title: The District C Vote
stops.body: Help choose where we land last. Your vote decides which {location} venue joins the crawl on March 19 as the community's third stop.
